text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s t-o a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-e-r-t l-o-g s t-a-m-p-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g r-a-t-e l-i-m-i-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d t-o g-a-i-n a-c-c-e-s-s, r-e-c-o-r-d-i-n-g t-h-e s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-w-n d-o-w-n g-i-f-t b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s f-o-r g-o-o-d-s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g i-n-v-o-i-c-e e-x-p-o-r-t s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d r-u-l-e t-e-s-t-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-d-e l-a-r-g-e p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s t-o c-o-n-v-e-r-t v-a-l-u-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-r-d-e-r h-i-s-t-o-r-y e-n-t-r-y s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-n-o-m-a-l-y t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-p-l-i-t t-h-e o-r-d-e-r-s a-c-r-o-s-s d-a-y-s t-o e-v-a-d-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g t-i-m-e-s-p-a-c-e-d l-o-g-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-r-a-f-f-i-c p-a-t-t-e-r-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
